    bands=[]
    start=0
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if r>start and all(v==0 for v in row[:7]):
            if r-start: bands.append((start,r))
            start=r+1
    if start<h: bands.append((start,h))
    for lo,hi in bands:

            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(lo,hi) if grid[r][c] not in (0,4,5)]
            for i,v in enumerate(vals[:hi-lo]):

    return out
